title: Your classes
lead: Pick a class to run it. The sample class shows what participants see, played by the four reference teams.
no_classes: You have no classes yet. An administrator adds you to one.
sample_note: Four reference teams play 2027, 2029 and 2031 in the future you pick. You can open it like any class.

future.title: The future for this class
future.lead: Participants don't see it until the replay. Choose one, or let the class draw one. It's fixed once a team confirms a year.
future.chosen: This class runs in the {future} future.
future.drawn: This class runs in the {future} future, drawn at random.
future.locked: A team has confirmed a year, so the future is fixed.
future.none: Choose the future before you open 2027.

notes.rapid: AI can do 60% of entry-level work by 2029; fees fall 7%. The verification wall comes in 2032 to 2033.
notes.complement: AI helps more than it replaces; fees fall 3% by 2029.
notes.constrained: AI stays costly and limited; fees fall 1% by 2029.

year.close_note: Closing confirms every team that hasn't confirmed, with the cards it has saved.
year.open_note: Teams move to {year} as soon as their CHRO confirms the year before.

teams.title: Teams in {year}
teams.closed_by_you: Confirmed when you closed the year
teams.reopen_note: Clears this team's confirm for {year}. Only their latest confirmed year can be reopened.

panel.title: Across the class in {year}
panel.lead: Confirmed teams only. A good opener for the discussion.
panel.alone: Teams with any workflow on AI alone

threads.title: Threads coming back
threads.lead: Each earlier choice and when it returns. The figure shows once the engine has run that year.

values.outage: {oversight} oversight; {alone} of 8 workflows on AI alone

values.wall: {drafts} of 8 workflows drafted by AI; extra checking capacity: {checking}
values.wall_seen: Checking needs {pct}% of the senior time it can have in 2032

replay.title: The replay
replay.lead: Each team's decisions held to 2035 in all three futures. Judgment is the worst overall result.
replay.waiting: The replay shows once every team has confirmed 2031.

errors.future_locked: A team has confirmed a year, so the future can't change.
errors.not_next: Years open and close in order.
errors.need_future: Choose the future before you open 2027.
errors.not_open: Open the year before you close it.
errors.cannot_reopen: Only a team's latest confirmed year can be reopened.
errors.not_enrolled: That person isn't in this class.
errors.other_class: That team is in another class.
errors.team_name_taken: Another team in this class has that name.
errors.team_in_use: Move its people off first. A team that has confirmed a year stays.
errors.only_participants: Only a participant login can be reset here.
errors.not_on_team: Put them on a team first.
errors.email_taken: That email already has a login.
errors.needs_instructor: A class needs an instructor login.
errors.started: This class has started, so it stays. Its record is part of the participants' work.
errors.closes_before_opens: Each year has to close after it opens.
errors.no_email: No line had a usable email.
errors.not_all_confirmed: Every team has to confirm the year first.
errors.no_paragraph: The team hasn't written its paragraph yet.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.lead: Times are in the class's time zone, {timezone}. A workshop runs a year every two hours; a term runs one year a week.
calendar.auto_run: Open and close each year on its own at these times
calendar.auto_note: If no future is chosen when 2027 is due, one is drawn.

roster.title: People and teams
roster.lead: Add people by email, or share the join link. Teams of four work best; three to five is fine.
roster.counts: {participants} in the class, {placed} on teams, {teams} teams.

add.title: Add people
add.hint: One per line: an email, "Name <email>", or "name, email". A spreadsheet's rows work too.
add.rejected: These lines had no usable email: {lines}

join.title: Join link
join.replace: Make a new link (the old one stops working)

teams.title: Teams
teams.form: Put everyone not on a team onto teams
teams.size_note: {count} people: teams work best with three to five.

admin.title: Classes and logins
admin.lead: Make instructor logins and classes, and say who teaches each one.

passwords.title: Passwords, shown once
passwords.lead: Copy these now. They won't show again, and only a scrambled copy is kept.

notes.existing: Had a login; added to the class
notes.instructor: An instructor login, so not added

ai.title: AI help in this class
ai.lead: Each switch turns one feature off for this class. With a switch off, people at the table give their fixed replies.
ai.server_off: AI is off on this server, so people at the table give their fixed replies.

features.paragraph: Daniel's reply to each team's paragraph
features.reading: The class reading after each year
features.debrief: The debrief note after the replay
